company.name: Magic Patterns
company.shortDescription: Magic Patterns aids software teams in prototyping with AI, offering design tools and export options to React and Figma.
company.description: Magic Patterns provides software tools that enable teams to prototype product ideas using AI-generated designs. The platform includes features for creating SVG and CSS patterns, gradients, and organic shapes, which can be applied to digital assets such as product visuals and social media content. Users can modify components and designs within the platform’s editor and export outputs to React or Figma formats. Magic Patterns also offers a Chrome extension that converts website elements into React components for use in development workflows.
